description: This file is a documentation source in Markdown format describing the 'Response' class and its methods, likely part of a larger documentation for a software library or API.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents responses received by a page, providing methods to access headers, body, status, and related information.

methods.name: Response.allHeaders
methods.description: Returns an object with all the response HTTP headers associated with this response.

methods.name: Response.body
methods.description: Returns the buffer with response body.

methods.name: Response.finished
methods.description: Waits for this response to finish, returning null or an error depending on the method variant.

methods.name: Response.frame
methods.description: Returns the Frame that initiated this response.

methods.name: Response.fromServiceWorker
methods.description: Indicates whether this Response was fulfilled by a Service Worker's Fetch Handler.

methods.name: Response.headers
methods.description: Returns an object with the response HTTP headers with lower-cased header names.

methods.name: Response.headersArray
methods.description: Returns an array of all request HTTP headers associated with this response, with header names not lower-cased.

methods.name: Response.headerValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the header matching the name.

methods.name: Response.headerValues
methods.description: Returns all values of headers matching the name.

methods.name: Response.json
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of response body.

methods.name: Response.ok
methods.description: Boolean indicating whether the response status is in the range 200-299.

methods.name: Response.request
methods.description: Returns the Request object associated with this response.

methods.name: Response.securityDetails
methods.description: Returns SSL and other security information related to the response.

methods.name: Response.serverAddr
methods.description: Returns the IP address and port of the server.

methods.name: Response.text
methods.description: Returns the text representation of response body.

methods.name: Response.url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the response.
